diagnosis.what_happened: Inline Latin script (English author names and technical terms) was inserted directly into Persian body text.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Mixed-script inline text violates formal Persian academic writing conventions and disrupts reading flow.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: All text within the running paragraph should have been in Persian script. Foreign author names must be transliterated phonetically, technical terms translated to Persian, and the original English terms placed exclusively in footnotes.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Strict Persian academic typographical rules mandate a visually cohesive LTR/RTL flow separation where Latin references appear as footnotes rather than breaking RTL paragraph continuity.

desired_behavior: Enforce zero Latin script in Persian body text. Transliterate all author names to Persian, use Persian equivalents for technical terms, and provide original English text strictly via footnotes.
generalization: Running Persian academic text must strictly contain zero Latin script words.
